title: Villager+
description: Villager+ brings more life to Minecraft villagers. This Mod adds unique villagers, new custom trading options, and more.
body:
Villager+ is a MCreator-made mod and is my very first Mod, which brings more life to Minecraft villagers. 
This Mod adds unique villagers, new custom trading options, and more.
Perfect for players who want a deeper village gameplay experience.

Features:
- New villager types, items, tools, blocks, and more 
- Custom trading 
- Custom villagers structure 
- Compatible with vanilla Minecraft
- Made with MCreator

You can find all other Older Versions on Curseforge [Here](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/villageplus)

## Reporting Bugs and Suggesting Features

I am using GitHub to collect bug reports and feature requests.  
Please submit all issues and feature requests. using the templates so I can track and fix them to the best of my ability. 

But be warned, I am not checking the page very often. 

- [Github](https://github.com/CurseWater71/My-Minecraft-Mods-Page/tree/main)

⚠️ Only use GitHub for bugs and features. Off-topic posts may be closed.

Bug reporting will help, but fixes will take time since I am new to this and not well-experienced in Minecraft modding yet.
